Why Retired NRIs Are Returning to This Indian Village?
In one Gujarat village, almost everyone is above 60. Yet nobody has to worry about cooking alone, getting to the hospital during an emergency, or eating dinner by themselves.
This is Chandanki in Mehsana district, Gujarat. With many younger people living in cities or abroad, elderly residents returning home found themselves facing the everyday challenges of retirement, from cooking and groceries to healthcare and loneliness.
